method: Original P1/P2 decoded previews inform silhouettes only. Greene and four monsters are individually authored cuboids using the accepted project Hunter/Supreme material style. Rejected r5 continuous Greene mesh and native texture are no longer shipped.
limitations: Static bind-pose previews are not original gameplay screenshots or original animation verification.
Some rigid source parts are displayed in their local coordinate system.
Roland and Galloway source identity remains unconfirmed; generic evolved package names are not sufficient evidence.
A passing asset test does not establish visual fidelity or user acceptance.
